verdict.rationale: Apify's API/SDK clients support running Actors at scale, batching via tasks with multiple input configs, pagination/limit controls, merging datasets, and streaming/retrieving large result sets, and webhooks allow chaining bulk runs; the CLI and API also allow scripted bulk control. Missing for 10: explicit documented bulk/batch endpoint (e.g. a single call to run N items in parallel) and independent hands-on confirmation of large-scale batch reliability.
